turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Look at this example first.
He has an egg. Step 1: say the noun, "egg". Step 2: the first sound is "e", a vowel sound. Step 3: so we write "an".
Rule: "an" before a vowel sound, "a" before other sounds.
Right: He has a cat. Wrong: He has an cat.
Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
